drone_interaction.vision_modality: Sub-surface root acoustic & thermal imaging (30-45mm diameter target)
drone_interaction.harvest_tool: Soft pneumatic suction-cup harvester detaching mature tubers without stolon tearing

exhaustive_medicinal_and_bioactive_compo.bioactive_mechanisms: Inhibition of hepatic glucose-6-phosphate translocase and antioxidant radical scavenging
exhaustive_medicinal_and_bioactive_compo.human_therapeutic_efficacy: Postprandial glycemic buffering and protection against lipid peroxidation
exhaustive_medicinal_and_bioactive_compo.extraction_or_utilization: Retained intact during steaming or roasting with skin

exhaustive_medicinal_and_bioactive_compo.bioactive_mechanisms: Prebiotic microbial fermentation into short-chain fatty acids (butyrate, propionate)
exhaustive_medicinal_and_bioactive_compo.human_therapeutic_efficacy: Colon epithelial barrier integrity, anti-inflammatory gut microbiome signaling
exhaustive_medicinal_and_bioactive_compo.extraction_or_utilization: Formed via retrogradation after steaming and cooling

penalties_and_risks: High foliage-to-tuber ratio requires automated canopy pruning to respect 4.5 ft vertical clearance.
Root misting sumps require light-tight seals to prevent chlorophyll and toxic glycoalkaloid (solanine) synthesis.
human_culinary_use: High-carbohydrate staple ration. Eaten steamed, baked, roasted whole, or dehydrated into dry mashed potato flakes.
